name: Acceptance-check result
description: run creates one result row per selected acceptance criterion. This diagram shows result modes, not feature maturity. resolve can update an existing row after receiving evidence; pass remains a separate true/false/null field.

meanings.executed: Command ran; pass may be true, false or unresolved.
meanings.needs_agent: Runner cannot execute the check; pass is null.
meanings.resolved: Evidence and an explicit verdict were stamped into an existing row.
